label: Kibe
note: Churned from soured whole milk, not from cream

about.text: Ethiopian butter churned from ergo, naturally soured whole milk, in a clay pot or bottle gourd, then washed in cold water. Spiced and clarified, it becomes niter kibbeh.

links.name: Livestock Research for Rural Development 19(7) (2007), Yilma et al.

how.label: ferment, churn
how.text: Raw milk sours spontaneously into ergo, mostly through lactic acid bacteria with yeasts adding flavour, and the acidified whole milk is churned back and forth in a sealed clay pot until fat grains clump. The butter can be spiced and melted into niter kibe.

links.name: Karssa et al. 2024, Food Sci Nutr (review, Ethiopian fermented milks)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Raw milk is accumulated over days in smoked clay pots and sours spontaneously or by back-slopping.
The ergo is shaken in a clay-pot churn.

steps.name: wash
steps.note: The butter is washed in cold water.
